description:
A terrifying scream coming from the woods led a compassionate woman to discover a frightened deer trapped in a fence, desperately needing help! 🥹🦌❤️
The woman was near her farm when she suddenly heard an unusual screaming sound coming from the nearby woods. Concerned that one of her farm animals might be in trouble, she immediately went to investigate.

Once free, the deer walked away and disappeared into the surrounding woods, bringing the unexpected rescue to a happy ending.

Day 8 of our Navratri recipe series brings these delicious homemade Coconut Almond Laddus 🪔✨
description:
Here’s how I made them:

First, add 1 whole coconut and 100 g almonds to boiling water and boil for 5 minutes.

Remove them from the water, peel the almonds and remove the outer skin of the coconut. Chop the coconut into small pieces.

Transfer the coconut and almonds to a grinder and grind into a fine powder.

Now, heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pan and add the prepared coconut-almond powder.

Add 1/4 cup sugar, 1/2 cup milk and some saffron soaked in milk. Mix everything well.

Cook until the mixture comes together and reaches a consistency that you can easily shape into laddus.

Let it cool slightly, shape into laddus and enjoy! 🥥🤍✨
